title: I keep having dreams about weird daycares/study rooms
content: lately, i haven’t had dreams about malls at all. my ‘mallworld’ type dreams tend to be a weird daycare/boarding school/tutoring center / study area sort of place. sometimes im in a colorful room with lots of bunk beds and desks. sometimes im in a library, or in a room with bunch of toys like a kindergarten. sometimes i’m with a few other kids or young adults. most of the time i’m by myself the most memorable one ive had recently was my apartment’s laundry room turned into a sprawling complex like this, with libraries, wood paneled study rooms with lots of plants and green upholstered chairs, free popcorn machines and a cafeteria at the very end of the labyrinth. no idea what this means, has anyone else had experiences like this? i can only guess that this is my brain trying to reminisce on when i went to a tutoring center after school for all of high school lol
